headline: Bitcoin held near $67,000 on Saturday after its lowest price since August, while XRP fell below $1 to its lowest level since November 2024.

market.asOf: Read about 11:57 UTC Sat 14 Nov (18:57 Bangkok) from CoinGecko's coin pages. Prices have moved since; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme Fear on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, but sources differ on the number: the index page showed 20 at about 12:15 UTC (28 the day before), while CryptoTicker reported a Saturday reading of 13.

stories.title: Bitcoin hovers near $67,000 after its lowest price since August
stories.summary: Bitcoin hit a new low overnight and then went flat on Saturday, staying around $67,000. It is on course for a sixth losing week in a row.
points: Bitcoin was around $67,200 on Saturday, per CryptoTicker.
Its 24-hour low was $66,491.67, the weakest since August, and the total crypto market fell 5.75% to $2.33 trillion, per Altcoin Buzz.
Bitcoin is on track for a sixth straight weekly decline, and is down 11% in November and 21% so far in 2026, per CoinDesk.
Daily bitcoin selling topped $850M, per TokenPost.
About $1.3B of bets on rising prices were wiped out on Friday, the 13th day in a year with more than $500M of liquidations, per Bloomberg via Business Standard.

sources.label: CoinDesk via Cryptonews: sixth weekly loss

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose over $1B for a second week as rate-hike bets stay high
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, the way many Americans hold bitcoin in a brokerage account, ended the week with a seventh straight day of withdrawals. Steady withdrawals mean steady selling. Markets also see a December Fed rate hike as very likely.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $185.4M on Friday 13 November, the seventh trading day in a row, per TokenPost.
Outflows were about $1.07B for the week of 9-13 November and about $2.35B over two weeks, per CryptoTicker using Farside data.
BlackRock's IBIT had its 11th straight day of outflows and lost about $908M over the week, per CryptoTicker.
Spot ether ETFs had a sixth straight day of outflows through 12 November, per The Defiant.
After Friday's wholesale-price data, CME FedWatch put the odds of a quarter-point December hike at 89.7%, per Cointelegraph.

stories.title: XRP falls below $1 to its lowest since November 2024
stories.summary: XRP slipped under $1 late on Friday US time. The drop came as US XRP funds marked their first birthday with money no longer flowing in.
points: XRP fell to about $0.99, its lowest since November 2024, per Bitcoin.com News.
XRP was down about 14% over seven days, per Bitcoin.com News.
US spot XRP ETFs turned one year old on 13 November with about $1.16B of net assets, per SoSoValue data reported by Bitcoin.com News.
Those funds have had no net inflows since 29 October and about $18.6M of net outflows in November, per Bitcoin.com News.
Ether was about $1,890 and Solana dipped under $75, per Bloomingbit.

briefs.title: Trump names new SEC and CFTC nominees
briefs.summary: Two picks for each agency, from both parties, including former CFTC commissioner Kristin Johnson for the SEC, per BitcoinWorld.

briefs.title: CFTC sues Arkansas over prediction markets
briefs.summary: The CFTC is challenging Arkansas's state rules for prediction markets such as Kalshi, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: CFTC approves Backpack Clearing
briefs.summary: Backpack's clearing arm was approved as a derivatives clearing organization on 13 November, per Coin Gabbar.

briefs.title: US moves to seize $1.2B from North Korea's Binance hack
briefs.summary: A court approved seizing or restraining more than $1.2B, part of more than $2.7B frozen so far, per The Block.

briefs.title: Hyperliquid sets an open-interest record
briefs.summary: It ended the third quarter with $16.8B of open futures bets, an 11.7% share that put it ahead of Bybit, Kraken and OKX, per The Block.

briefs.title: MSCI to drop Strategy after 30 November
briefs.summary: Strategy estimated about $2.8B of its shares could be sold because of the removal; J.P. Morgan says up to $8.8B if other index providers follow, per IBTimes.

briefs.title: MegaETH cuts staff
briefs.summary: MegaETH is cutting 20% of its staff, per The Block.
